title: Men's Basic Crew Neck Cotton T-Shirt, Pack of 3
description:
Three everyday essentials in one pack: soft cotton crew neck tees with a regular fit that work on their own or under shirts and jackets.
• Material: 100% cotton jersey, 160 g/m²
• Ribbed crew neck with taped shoulder seams
• Pack of 3: white, black and grey
• Pre-shrunk; machine wash at 40°C

title: Men's Heavyweight Relaxed Fit T-Shirt
description:
A thick, durable tee with a boxy relaxed fit and slightly dropped shoulders for a modern casual look.
• Material: 100% cotton, heavyweight 240 g/m² jersey
• Wide ribbed crew neck that keeps its shape
• Relaxed body with longer sleeves
• Colours: yellow, green and black
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Slim Fit Stretch Cotton T-Shirt
description:
A close-fitting tee with a touch of stretch that keeps its shape wash after wash, for a clean look under a jacket or on its own.
• Material: 95% cotton, 5% elastane jersey
• Crew neckline with a narrow rib
• Slim fit through the chest and arms
• Colours: white, black and light green
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Long Sleeve Oxford Button-Down Shirt
description:
A versatile Oxford shirt with a soft, textured weave and a button-down collar, smart enough for work and relaxed enough for weekends.
• Material: 100% cotton Oxford cloth
• Button-down collar, chest pocket and buttoned cuffs
• Regular fit with a curved hem
• Colours: grey and light blue
• Machine wash at 40°C, iron on medium heat

title: Men's Linen Blend Casual Shirt, Long Sleeve
description:
A breathable linen-blend shirt with a relaxed fit, made for summer evenings, holidays and warm office days with the sleeves rolled up.
• Material: 55% linen, 45% cotton
• Classic collar and full button front
• Long sleeves with button cuffs and roll-up tabs
• Colours: tan and white
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Classic Cotton Pique Polo Shirt
description:
A timeless short sleeve polo in breathable cotton pique, with a neat ribbed collar that holds its shape.
• Material: 100% cotton pique, 200 g/m²
• Ribbed collar and cuffs with a two-button placket
• Side vents and a slightly longer back hem
• Colours: navy and white
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Men's Printed Short Sleeve Polo Shirt
description:
A summery polo with a small all-over print in soft, quick-drying jersey that stays comfortable on warm days.
• Material: 100% polyester jersey with a light, smooth feel
• Self collar with a three-button placket
• Regular fit with short sleeves
• Colour: light blue pattern
• Machine wash at 30°C; dries quickly

title: Men's Full-Zip Hoodie with Brushed Fleece Lining
description:
A go-to zip-up hoodie with a soft brushed interior, easy to throw on over a tee for walks, gym runs and cool evenings.
• Material: 80% cotton, 20% polyester, 280 g/m² fleece
• Full-length metal zip and drawcord hood
• Two front pockets; ribbed cuffs and hem
• Colours: grey and black
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: Men's Fleece Pullover Hoodie with Kangaroo Pocket
description:
A cosy pullover hoodie with a warm fleece inside and a classic regular fit for everyday wear.
• Material: 70% cotton, 30% polyester fleece
• Double-layer hood with drawcord
• Front kangaroo pocket; ribbed cuffs and hem
• Colours: black and white
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Crew Neck Knit Sweater in Soft Wool Blend
description:
A classic fine-knit crew neck jumper that layers neatly over a shirt collar or works alone with chinos and jeans.
• Material: 50% acrylic, 30% nylon, 20% wool
• Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and hem
• Regular fit, approx. 70 cm long in size L
• Colours: red and grey
• Hand wash cold or use a wool cycle; dry flat

title: Men's Slim Fit Stretch Jeans, Dark Wash
description:
Slim jeans with a comfortable stretch that moves with you, in a dark wash that dresses up or down.
• Material: 98% cotton, 2% elastane
• Mid rise with zip fly and button fastening
• Slim leg tapering slightly to the ankle
• Inside leg 32 in (81 cm)
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: Men's Regular Fit Straight Leg Jeans
description:
Classic straight leg jeans with a regular fit through the seat and thigh, cut from sturdy denim that softens with every wash.
• Material: 100% cotton denim, 12.5 oz, mid-blue wash
• Mid rise with zip fly and button fastening
• Five-pocket styling and belt loops
• Inside leg 32 in (81 cm)
• Machine wash at 30°C inside out

title: Men's Slim Fit Stretch Chino Trousers
description:
Smart-casual chinos with a slim cut and a little stretch for comfort at the desk and beyond.
• Material: 97% cotton, 3% elastane twill
• Zip fly with button fastening and belt loops
• Two slant front pockets and two back welt pockets
• Colours: beige and tan
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Cotton Cargo Trousers with Six Pockets
description:
Hard-wearing cargo trousers with plenty of storage, comfortable for outdoor days, travel and weekend projects.
• Material: 100% cotton twill
• Elasticated back waistband with belt loops and zip fly
• Six pockets, including two side cargo pockets with flaps
• Relaxed straight leg
• Colours: brown and olive

title: Men's Cotton Chino Shorts, Knee Length
description:
Neat knee-length chino shorts in lightweight cotton for summer days in town or on holiday.
• Material: 98% cotton, 2% elastane twill
• Zip fly with button fastening and belt loops
• Two side pockets and two back pockets
• Inseam approx. 23 cm
• Colours: green, navy and beige

title: Men's Classic Bomber Jacket with Ribbed Trims
description:
A lightweight bomber jacket with a lightly padded lining, ideal as an in-between layer for spring and autumn.
• Shell: 100% polyester twill; lining: 100% polyester with light padding
• Front zip with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem
• Two side pockets and a zipped sleeve pocket
• Colours: brown and black
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Men's Hooded Puffer Jacket with Water-Repellent Shell
description:
A warm, quilted puffer jacket with a hood and a water-repellent outer, built for cold, damp winter days.
• Shell and lining: 100% nylon; padding: polyester fibre fill
• Fixed hood, high collar and two-way front zip
• Two zip hand pockets and one inner pocket
• Elasticated cuffs and adjustable hem
• Colours: black and navy

title: Men's Slim Fit Two-Piece Suit, Jacket and Trousers
description:
A sharp slim fit suit for weddings, interviews and the office, with a two-button jacket and matching flat-front trousers.
• Material: 65% polyester, 35% viscose; jacket lining: 100% polyester
• Jacket: notch lapels, two-button front, two flap pockets and a chest pocket
• Trousers: flat front, zip fly and unfinished hem for easy tailoring
• Set includes jacket and trousers
• Dry clean recommended

title: Men's Quick-Dry Training Shorts with Zip Pocket
description:
Light, breathable training shorts that dry quickly, made for the gym, running and outdoor workouts.
• Material: 100% polyester woven fabric with stretch
• Elastic waistband with an internal drawcord
• Two side pockets and a zipped back pocket
• Inseam approx. 18 cm
• Colours: black and grey

title: Men's Quick-Dry Swim Shorts with Mesh Lining
description:
Comfortable swim shorts that dry fast, with a breathable mesh lining for beach days, pool sessions and holidays.
• Material: 100% polyester, quick-drying
• Elastic waistband with drawcord
• Two side pockets and a back pocket with drainage eyelets
• Inseam approx. 15 cm
• Rinse in cool water after use
